summary.en: Pakistani security forces killed three TTP-linked terrorists on the outskirts of Peshawar and fifteen terrorists in Mastung district, Balochistan, continuing operations against militant groups. A Pakistani national was critically injured in an Iranian attack, while two Pakistani military personnel were killed and seven detained in Balochistan operations involving the BLA. Near the Iran border, three Afghan migrants, including a woman and a child, were found shot dead. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker drepte tre TTP-tilknyttede terrorister på utkanten av Peshawar og femten terrorister i Mastung-distriktet i Balochistan, i fortsatte operasjoner mot militante grupper. En pakistansk statsborger ble kritisk såret i et iransk angrep, mens to pakistanske militærpersonell ble drept og sju ble pågrepet i Balochistan-operasjoner som involverte BLA. Nær grensen til Iran ble tre afghanske migranter, inkludert en kvinne og et barn, funnet skutt døde. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
